Overview.Name: Sreekanth Maharaju
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2–3 eggs) & cooked vegetables
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable fry
Meal_2 (Dinner - lighter): Option 3: Paneer pan fried (120 g) + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid reused oil foods and outside fried foods completely.
Keep meals less oily to reduce inflammation and support spine recovery.
Start meals with chicken, eggs or paneer before eating rice.
Long sitting hours can worsen disk bulge discomfort, so take small walking breaks regularly.
Consistent yoga, walking and proper meal timing will improve energy and body composition.
